name: circle-walk
description: Gait-policy walk in a closed circle: forward 0.4 + yaw 0.45 stick for 10s, then stop.
notes: Stick units, not m/s — env maps onto active gait envelope. Larger yaw = tighter circle; flip yaw sign for the other direction. Runs through the RL gait policy (WALK branch), not DIRECT_JOINT.
